items.summary: An innovative pilot project for a circular, vegetated public space. This new urban setting for Vicálvaro has an impact that transcends the local level, benefiting the entire city of Madrid .

items.title: Yet another price rise: AMD will reportedly raise its graphics card and memory prices alongside Nvidia
items.summary: Hot on the heels of Nvidia reportedly raising the price of its graphics cards and memory units comes word that rival component manufacturer AMD will do the same. Read more

items.title: "Plants on a building doesn't make it sustainable, any more than a basil leaf on a steak makes it vegan"
items.summary: Plans for a large new building in Rotterdam intended to encourage people to lead more environmentally friendly lifestyles are wrong-headed and should be scrapped in a blaze of publicity, writes Barnabas Calder.

items.title: Plug-in solar panels to be available in UK by end of summer
items.summary: The UK government has announced the arrival of plug-in solar panels that can be fitted onto balconies to reduce household energy costs.
